title: Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
Title: Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable Specialist 
Location: Saint Louis, MN- Onsite 
Employment Type: Contract to Hire 
Compensation: $23-$25/hour 

Overview:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our finance team. This entry-level position is ideal for individuals looking to start or grow their career in accounting or corporate finance. The role involves supporting daily AP/AR functions, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring timely processing of payments and receipts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process vendor invoices and employee expense reimbursements accurately and efficiently.

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices and apply incoming payments to accounts.

  • Maintain and update vendor and customer records, ensuring compliance with W-9 and 1099 requirements.

  • Assist with reconciling accounts, researching discrepancies, and maintaining data accuracy.

  • Support monthly and year-end close activities by preparing reports and documentation.

  • Communicate effectively with internal departments and external vendors to resolve billing or payment inquiries.

  • Maintain confidentiality and adhere to company accounting policies and procedures.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree preferred (required for promotion to senior-level roles).

  • Experience: 1–2 years of office or corporate experience preferred; AP/AR background a plus but not required.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (basic to intermediate; VLOOKUP, formatting, data entry).

    • Strong general computer literacy and attention to detail.

  • Knowledge of: W-9 and 1099 forms, and understanding of reportable vs. non-reportable vendors (can be trained).

Ideal Candidate Attributes:

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and data accuracy.

  • Eager to learn and develop new skills in accounting and finance.

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Reliable, motivated, and a team player with a positive attitude.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer – ML Ops (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform)
Location:  Denver, CO (Hybrid)
Department: Technology & Innovation
Contract to hire
 
Job Summary:
****  is seeking a skilled and driven DevOps Engineer to join our ML Ops team. This role is critical in enabling scalable, secure, and efficient machine learning infrastructure across the organization. You will work at the intersection of DevOps and MLOps, supporting data scientists and machine learning engineers in deploying, monitoring, and maintaining ML models in production using modern DevOps best practices.
You'll be leveraging tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines in a cloud-native environment (AWS preferred) to streamline workflows, reduce deployment time, and improve operational efficiency for ML-driven initiatives.
 
Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for deploying ML models and supporting infrastructure.
  • Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters for containerized ML workloads and services.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform to provision and manage AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with ML engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to ensure reliable deployment and monitoring of ML models.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration management, and deployment processes to ensure repeatability and scalability.
  • Monitor infrastructure and applications using observability tools; proactively troubleshoot and resolve system issues.
  • Ensure security, compliance, and cost optimization across the ML Ops infrastructure.
  • Contribute to internal tooling and platform improvements that empower ML teams to work efficiently.
 
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Engineering.
  • Proficient in Kubernetes (EKS preferred) for container orchestration and management.
  • Strong experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, ArgoCD).
  • Deep understanding of Terraform for infrastructure automation and IaC best practices.
  • Solid experience working in AWS environments (EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, VPC, CloudFormation, etc.).
  • Familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).
  • Experience supporting ML pipelines or data science teams is a strong plus.
  • Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills; collaborative and team-oriented mindset.
 
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with ML platforms or MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, Kubeflow).
  • Knowledge of GitOps practices and tools like ArgoCD or Flux.
  • Familiarity with container build tools (Docker, BuildKit).
  • Experience in highly regulated environments (security and compliance focus).
  • AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
 
Why Join Us:
  • Work on impactful projects at the intersection of AI/ML and infrastructure.
  • Be part of a growing and innovative ML Ops team.
  • Access to cutting-edge cloud and ML technologies.
  • Competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and career development opportunities.

We’re looking for someone bilingual in Spanish and English, dependable, and confident under pressure. If you have a background in appliance, furniture, or warehouse work, or simply enjoy being the go-to problem solver who keeps operations moving, this role is for you.

You’ll be part of a high-energy team that thrives on problem-solving and delivering great service. If you’re dependable, proactive, and ready to grow your career in a fast-moving logistics environment, we want to meet you.

title: Loan Servicing Specialist
description:
Loan Processor / Title Specialist
Pay: $20 - $22 /hr
Location: Minneapolis, MN (Onsite, 5 days a week)
Openings: 8 positions

Overview:
Are you detail-oriented and thrive in a structured, process-driven environment? Join our client's Title Team as an Loan/Title Operations Specialist and play a key role in ensuring accurate and timely release of vehicle and equipment titles. With thousands of monthly transactions and service deadlines, your work will directly support customers by ensuring lien releases, corrections, and compliance are handled efficiently.
 

Position Overview
The Loan Servicing / Title Specialists are responsible for releasing vehicle and equipment titles once loans or leases are paid off, as well as auditing and correcting title documents received from customers, dealerships, and DMVs. This role requires high attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage work queues and service requests with accuracy. All work is performed onsite at the Minneapolis office due to the secure handling of physical titles.


Responsibilities

  • Release vehicle and equipment titles after loan or lease payoff

  • Sign off lienholder information and send physical titles via FedEx or process electronic titles through DMV systems

  • Reassign lease titles, prepare bills of sale, and process power of attorney documentation as required

  • Audit incoming titles from DMVs and customers for accuracy

  • Research errors and prepare correction packets for resolution with dealerships, customers, or DMVs

  • Manage service requests (SRs) to ensure timely processing and adherence to SLAs


Qualifications

  • Experience in commercial loan processing, vehicle/equipment/mortgage title work, dealership title office, DMV, or title agency strongly preferred

  • Strong document review and audit skills with ability to identify and resolve discrepancies

  • Proficiency in Excel and comfort managing personal queues/pipelines

  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and reliability


Work Schedule & Logistics

  • Monday–Friday, 8:00–4:30 (30-min lunch) or 8:00–5:00 (1-hr lunch)

  • Occasional mandatory overtime (approx. 1 hour/day during peak periods)

  • Onsite only — physical titles are housed in the downtown Minneapolis office

Compensation: $55K-70K annual
Job Type: Direct Hire 
Start Date: ASAP

Job Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Project Accountant to join our team full-time. This position is responsible for overseeing the financial management of large-scale, multi-million-dollar projects from inception through completion. The Project Accountant ensures accurate contract setup, billing, job cost tracking, and compliance with client and company standards, including AIA billing requirements. This role serves as a key liaison between project management and accounting teams, supporting financial accuracy and project profitability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review and interpret contract terms to establish proper project accounting structures and ensure compliance with billing and reporting requirements.

  • Prepare and process project invoices, including AIA billing, time and materials, and milestone billings.

  • Track and reconcile job costs, verifying alignment with budgets, forecasts, and contract provisions.

  • Maintain detailed records of project expenditures, commitments, change orders, and revenue recognition.

  • Monitor accounts receivable, manage collections, and collaborate with clients to resolve billing or payment issues.

  • Support project managers with budget analysis, financial reporting, and variance explanations.

  • Assist with month-end close processes, including accruals, revenue adjustments, and project reconciliations.

  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of all financial documentation related to assigned projects.

  • Partner with internal teams to streamline accounting processes and improve financial visibility across projects.

Qualifications:

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (required).

  • 3–5 years of experience in project accounting, job cost accounting, or construction/contract billing.

  • Demonstrated experience with AIA billing and complex project financial management.

  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, cost accounting principles, and contract compliance.

  • Proficiency in accounting and ERP systems; strong Excel skills required.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities with a high level of accuracy.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and with external clients.

title: Accountant
description:
The position has responsibility for the day-to-day accounting for a number of timber investment companies and associated structural entities ( "Funds”). We expect the Accountant to take full ownership of Funds allocated to them, as well as perform duties supporting the Chief Accountant. The applicant should have a good understanding of balance sheets, income statements and cash flows, including the financial transactions that impact these statements. The ability to meet deadlines is vital in our fast-paced environment.


Full cycle accounting duties include:
  • Daily accounting duties including payment reviews, invoice reviews and posting;
  • Booking new property acquisitions, and timber and land sales;
  • Monthly soft close of AP, AR and GL for assigned Funds within the department's deadlines. Closes involve full reconciliations, updates to accruals and prepayments, and preparation of monthly closing packets;
  • Quarterly hard close to include fair value posting of timberland and other assets, and production of quarterly reporting templates;
  • Complex journals including intercompany transactions in varying currencies;
  • Consolidations with eliminations and foreign currency, where appropriate.

Related duties:
  • Ability to articulate Fund performance and major factors impacting quarterly results;
  • Take part in the annual budget process, and complete budget variance analysis throughout the year;
  • Research issues and respond to questions on assigned Funds;
  • Communication with in-country bookkeeping / accounting service providers as needed;
  • Provide support initially, and ultimately lead, the independent international audit program;
  • Analysis and special projects, as needed, under the guidance of managers;
  • Corporate capital reconciliations;
  • Financial reporting, maintenance, account reconciliation and analysis of the general ledger and books of original entry, and the maintenance and documentation of internal accounting controls;
  • Reconciliation of quarterly fair market value to internal systems Power BI, MS Dynamics;
  • Prepare various subsidiary and auxiliary reports for both external and internal clients;
  • Focus on and adherence to all financial reporting deadlines being met

Qualifications & Experience
  • Bachelor's Degree in accounting or finance, or equivalent experience;
  • Good understanding of US-GAAP and exposure to IFRS;
  • Exposure to consolidations and eliminations, and multi-currency financial statements;
  • Takes ownership of Funds and tasks, and delivers against both personal and team goals;
  • Team player who shares knowledge with colleagues;
  • Solid MS Office skills, particularly excel and word;
  • Knowledge of MS D365-Ops accounting system a plus; and
  • Spanish or Portuguese skills a plus.

title: Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Job Title: Manufacturing Engineer
Location: Stow, OH

Job Summary

The Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for developing, improving, and supporting all production processes related to the launch, manufacture, and testing of products within an assigned value stream or product line. This role provides technical guidance, mentorship to junior engineers, and prioritizes workloads based on production needs.

Working as part of an experienced engineering team, you will interpret complex designs, create 3D models, program multi-axis CNC machines, and implement process improvements to support efficient, high-quality production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, evaluate, and improve manufacturing processes while ensuring compliance with design specifications.

  • Program equipment, generate CNC code, and perform tool path simulations.

  • Serve as the primary contact for design engineering and program management on manufacturing process issues.

  • Create and maintain manufacturing methods, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and labor standards within ERP systems.

  • Participate in continuous improvement (CI) and cost reduction initiatives.

  • Design, construct, and validate tooling, fixtures, gauges, and equipment.

  • Optimize workflow and cell layout with a focus on waste reduction and process efficiency.

  • Analyze manufacturing variances and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues in a machining environment.

  • Collaborate with Supply Chain and Quality teams to support supplier development activities.

  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior manufacturing engineers.

  • Support and resolve customer complaints and concerns related to manufacturing.

  • Contribute to Lean manufacturing and companywide continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Complete required training and follow all safety protocols, including the use of PPE.

Qualifications

  • 5–10 years of manufacturing engineering experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of CAD and CAM software experience (Mastercam preferred).

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Inventor, or similar 3D modeling software.

  • Experience with tooling selection and fixture design.

  • Ability to read and interpret complex 2D blueprints and 3D models.

  • Strong understanding of GD&T principles.

  • Hands-on experience with manual and CNC machining equipment, including multi-axis (5+) programming.

  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and statistical analysis skills.

  • Proven ability to implement process changes and train employees in a production environment.

  • Excellent technical, written, and verbal communication skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Ability to perform physical tasks as required, including occasional lifting of up to 40 lbs.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Manufacturing Engineering preferred (not required).
